title: Jack Rabbit Mandarin Cheesecake Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Jack Rabbit’s Mandarin Cheesecake lends a rich, luxurious, creamy cheesecake base a delicious biscuit base with a fresh and fruity mandarin coulis for a dreamily indulgent all-day vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
